Kat Macdonald is a London-based sound and media artist exploring collective practice, embodiment and technology. She is the founder of the London Community Laptop Orchestra and a long time member of the Design And Performance Lab (DAP Lab).

Her work uses pedagogy, open scoring and collective activations as a method to draw attention to social systems and infrastructures that lie unacknowledged in everyday life. Through noticing these forces, we can then make decisions around how we orientate ourselves around them.

⚇ creative intelligence ( September 2026 ) ⚇

The London Community Laptop Orchestra got to perform at the Southbank Centre as part of Creative Intelligence. Thanks so Peckham Digital for progamming us!


⚇ digital micro publics ( September 2026 ) ⚇

I led a lecture / workshop at Termite begining research into the topic of “what is a digital micro public?”
